title: Livelier clan battles
changes: In big battles the two lines now march in and clash in the middle, and the wings and second rank join the fight instead of standing back.
Soldiers stay on the foe they are fighting instead of turning from one to the next, and spread along the front instead of piling onto one man.
Soldiers walk round trees and rocks instead of getting stuck against them.
Your area damage and blows now hit the soldiers of any clan but your own: striking a clan that left you alone makes its soldiers fight you, as provoking does.
